name: Light → Addressable Set
description: This [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) allows you to manually set a range of LEDs on an addressable light to a specific color.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the addressable light to control.

config_entries.label: Blue
config_entries.description: The value to set the blue channel to.

config_entries.label: Color
config_entries.description: A [standard CSS color name](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/named-color) or a hex value in the form `0xRRGGBB` to use instead of **red**, **green** and **blue**. Not templatable. Also sets **color_brightness**, as described in [light state](https://esphome.io/components/light/#light-state).

config_entries.label: Color Brightness
config_entries.description: The brightness to set the color channel to.

config_entries.label: Green
config_entries.description: The value to set the green channel to.

config_entries.label: Range From
config_entries.description: The beginning of the range of LEDs to control, inclusive, using zero-based indexing. Defaults to 0 (the beginning of the strip).

config_entries.label: Range To
config_entries.description: The end of the range of LEDs to control, inclusive, using zero-based indexing. Defaults to the end of the strip (`num_leds` - 1).

config_entries.label: Red
config_entries.description: The value to set the red channel to.

config_entries.label: White
config_entries.description: The brightness to set the white channel to.
